question: Find the display name of the user who owns the most valuable post (by FavoriteCount) among posts that satisfy all of the following: (1) the post has a view count between 100 and 150, (2) the post has at least one comment with a score between 1 and 5, (3) the post owner has zero downvotes, and (4) the post was edited by someone in 2011 (as recorded in postHistory).

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_055 FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 WHERE p.XCL_030 BETWEEN 100 AND 150 AND u.XCL_062 = 0 AND p.XCL_026 IN (SELECT c.XCL_006 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND p.XCL_026 IN (SELECT ph.XCL_014 FROM postHistory AS ph WHERE ph.XCL_013 = 2 AND STRFTIME('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2011') ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC LIMIT 1

measures.multiplicity_argument: One favorite_count per post; no aggregation needed

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_030 BETWEEN 100 AND 150
  AND u.XCL_062 = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      AND c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
      AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
      AND strftime('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2011'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_030 BETWEEN 100 AND 150
  AND u.XCL_062 = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      AND c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
      AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
      AND strftime('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2011'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1
